As previously mentioned, every process that executes on a host has a corresponding ProcessRollup2 event. This means that when a process spawns another
process, a brand new ProcessRollup2 event will be generated for that new ProcessRollup2event. This new event will contain a field called
ParentProcessId. The ParentProcessId of the child PR2 will match the TargetProcessId of the parent PR2, as shown below :

ProcessRollup2 events.
